narrative:
Monroe County has 8,633 registered voters, with 23.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 18.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 31.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 33.3% of registrants.
